scope: Individual non-last group member exit(93), original parent-thread relationships and death-signal registration, original resource retirement, mm quiescence notification and PID/signal visibility. Final process/group cleanup remains open.

benchmark.method: Seven counterbalanced before/after pairs for each CPU count and rounds value. Four already-ready threads register addresses, restore their clear_tid address and exit. Interval includes release and clear_tid joins, excludes clone/setup and final stack unmap. Remaining owner projection collection is not claimed as completed before joins.
benchmark.native_reference: Exact static musl ELF on existing ARM Linux Lima instance, six vCPUs, one/four-CPU affinity. Not bare-metal Darwin. Seven fresh samples per affinity for the short case; unchanged 1000-round native samples reused from the previous task-resource batch after verifying ELF SHA256.
benchmark.claims: Focused join/exit latency only. No meaningful single-CPU gain. No whole-browser speedup claim. Performance build uses the same runtime source before pin metadata changed; final signed pinned package accepted independently.
benchmark.single_cpu_followup: An initial roughly 4 us short-case regression prompted removal of unused survivor selection/process scans for childless exits. Final short medians are 43084/43417 ns.

suites.reuse_note: Native full affected results precede only the final pure childless-survivor-selection optimization and private helper cleanup. Apple affected tests, final clean functional/stress binaries and strict checks cover that optimization. Unchanged VFS/ABI/CPU/GPU results are reused; integration is reused after that semantic-preserving optimization.

integration_workload.go_gc: 30 stock Debian Docker CLI starts, GOGC=1, normal asynchronous preemption
integration_workload.docker: Eight isolated twelve-CPU start/health/exec/inspect/stop/remove cycles with public cached Alpine content
integration_workload.storage: Private regression store; no business deployment/frontend operation

regressions: Source individual exit releases original Files, clear_tid and cgroup membership without stopping live peers or requesting a service.
Sixteen simultaneous exitters keep exactly one last live group member.
Owner controls defer before effects; actual legacy futex adoption requests its existing boundary after accepted cleanup.
clear_tid wakes one waiter and ignores its user write fault.
Original parent-thread links survive non-leader exec/future TID publication, explicit reparenting, repeated retirement and numeric TID reuse.
Filtered parent-death registration ALLOW/ERRNO operates on original task state without a checkpoint.
Non-leader presence retires before owner projection collection; leader presence and live process signal routing remain.
Owner group exit/exec mark removed original tasks dead and preserve parent-death and io_uring cancellation.

lost_mm_notification.description: An exiting peer returned the final active View while another task held an mm checkpoint, but Epoch::finish omitted VmReady because it previously always stopped the cohort. Captured queue had finished source thread 4, parked root 1, held requester 2 and a woken requester futex.
lost_mm_notification.fix: Publish original domains.notify_ready after returning the final View; no all-cohort stop/retry/poll workaround.

native_namespace_oracle_difference.failure: Existing negative ioprio_get assertion expects EINVAL; native syscall probe returns ESRCH. Fixture was stopped after the resulting wait. No assertion weakened.

remaining_boundaries: Last group member, exit_group and default fatal termination still require actual group/process cleanup
Full reparenting/subreaper and namespace-init teardown, robust-futex support and final mm/native ownership
Actual owner epoll/namespace/proc/mount destructors, legacy ancillary reaping, tracing/vfork and accepted owner/mapped-file work
Other non-source completions still stop their execution cohort; source exit does not imply all lifecycle migration is complete

execution.relationship_synchronization: Original parent graph transaction only for structural changes; scalar registration is relaxed atomic. Ordinary capture and childless exit do not select a survivor.
execution.callbacks: After original resource locks are released
